UN Envoy Warns of Escalation in Yemen, Middle East Travel Advisories Issued

A United Nations envoy has warned that Yemen has returned to a "full-scale war" and urged for dialogue. Concurrently, the U.S. Embassy in Jordan and an EU aviation group have issued advisories against traveling to the Middle East. An Israeli UN envoy also stated that the UK's role in the Middle East "will not be the same."
